answers.q1: Cargo (Rust, edition 2024, MSRV 1.96) is the build tool. It fetches dependencies as part of the build, so there is no separate install step. To fetch them up front, run `cargo fetch --locked`. To fetch and build, run `cargo build`.
answers.q2: `cargo test --workspace`. This is what CI runs, and CI adds `--features unstable-index` and `--features pcre2` in separate passes. The README's `cargo test --all` is equivalent to `cargo test --workspace`.
answers.q3: `cargo test --test it regression::`. The integration target in Cargo.toml is named `it`, not `integration` as AGENTS.md says. Tests/tests.rs declares `mod regression;`, so the `regression::` filter selects only tests/regression.rs.
answers.q4: CI runs `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`. It also runs `RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items --workspace` and `ci/test-complete`. The last one needs zsh and a built `rg`. AGENTS.md says CI has no clippy step, but ci.yml does have one in the rustfmt job.
answers.q5: `target/` holds build output and is gitignored. The man page and shell completions are generated by build.rs into the build output directory, so don't hand-edit those artifacts. Change `crates/core/flags/defs.rs` instead, because docs and completions derive from it. I found no vendored directories. `Cargo.lock` is tool-maintained, so don't edit it by hand.

q1.reason: Names Cargo, says no separate install step, and gives cargo fetch / cargo build, matching ACCEPT.

q2.reason: Gives `cargo test --workspace`, which matches ACCEPT, and the extra CI detail does not contradict the truth.

q3.reason: `cargo test --test it regression::` matches the ACCEPT list exactly.

q4.reason: Gives both `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, plus the cargo doc check as a bonus.

q5.reason: It lists target/ and Cargo.lock (accepted) and finds no vendored dirs, but it also says build.rs-generated man page and completions are not to be hand-edited. That goes beyond the 'none' truth, though it names no repo directory from the REJECT list.
